name: UUID Generator
description: Generate UUIDs (v1/v3/v4/v5/v7), ULIDs, NanoIDs and Snowflake IDs, and inspect existing identifiers
help: v4 is random; v7 starts with a timestamp and sorts naturally, great for database keys; v1 embeds time (with a random node ID instead of your MAC address).
v3 / v5 are derived from a namespace and a name; the same input always yields the same UUID.
ULID and NanoID are shorter and URL friendly; NanoID supports custom length and alphabet.
Inspect accepts UUIDs (with braces, uppercase or without hyphens) and ULIDs and reveals embedded timestamps.

Snowflake IDs support Twitter / MyBatis-Plus, Meituan Leaf, Baidu UidGenerator and Discord presets plus custom bit layouts; paste a numeric ID to decode its time, worker and sequence under each layout.

snowflake.epochHint: Time inside the ID counts from this moment
snowflake.layout: 64 bits = 1 sign + {{time}} time ({{unit}}) + {{datacenter}} datacenter + {{worker}} worker + {{sequence}} sequence
snowflake.monotonic: IDs from the same layout strictly increase: the sequence grows within a tick, borrows the next tick when exhausted, and keeps the last time if the clock goes backwards.
